Inducted field geologist warrant with field geologists verification demands a one-per-person interview slot that books out months ahead, so scale means waiting, not just paying. One honest agent passes in minutes; a farm faces the same charge on every name it invents, and the inlet is that the reward per clone never rises to meet it. The echo here is simple: a warrant geologists confirm after survey audits, and that proof cannot be lent to a second identity. The shale is a spreadsheet that turns red long before the farm turns a profit.
